verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a few specific product-owned automations that run unattended once configured. Scheduled Rollouts gradually deploy a feature over time, and Autotune bandits automatically and dynamically reallocate traffic toward the winning variant. There is no evidence of a general-purpose automation builder or agentic background jobs. CI/CD use of the CLI is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: a general configurable automation/workflow engine, AI- or agent-driven background tasks, triggers and recurring schedules beyond rollouts, run history and monitoring of automations, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Gradually deploy a feature over time by setting up a Feature Gate as a Scheduled Rollout.
They automatically find the best variant among a group of candidates while dynamically allocating traffic to optimize for a single target metric.
Autotune shifts traffic toward the winning variant to maximize a target metric.
